newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise up after Italian drilling report.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise up after Italian drilling report.

text.p: Shares in Enterprise Oil Plc rose against a falling UK stock market on Wednesday after the company said it had completed a successful appraisal of an oil discovery in southern Italy, dealers said.

"The Italian strike is seen as very bullish, it is very positive news for Enterprise," said one trader. The stock was up 5p at 646-1/2 by 1026 GMT, close to its record 650p set December 31, even as the FTSE 100 index dropped 29.1 points to 4,208.3.
Earlier Enterprise said production at its Cerro Falcone discovery in the south Appenine area would by put on long term production later this year.

Simon Oddie, Enterprise's general manager in Rome, said the results of the appraisal had been "excellent." He said the company had obtained reservoir and well as test information from three separate wellbore sections using only a single primary well. "The positive implications for the development of Cerro Falcone and the whole Val d'Agri are substantial," Oddie said.
